title: Find rest areas in NSW
summary: This page helps you find rest areas in NSW to take safe breaks when driving long distances.
intro:
It’s important to take regular breaks when driving long distances. Rest areas (or rest stops) are places where you can park safely, get out of your vehicle and refresh yourself. They’re available 24 hours a day, every day of the year.
